Northwind Financial — Fabric IQ POC sample data
================================================

Upload these into your Fabric Lakehouse (NorthwindLakehouse) under Files:

  Files/
    landing/
      payments/   <- upload EVERYTHING from the payments folder here
      lending/    <- upload EVERYTHING from the lending folder here
    truth/        <- upload truth_customer_crosswalk.csv here

Steps in the portal:
  1. Open your Lakehouse -> Explorer.
  2. Under Files, create folders: landing, landing/payments, landing/lending, truth.
  3. Select landing/payments -> ... -> Upload -> Upload files -> pick all CSVs in payments\.
  4. Select landing/lending -> Upload -> pick all CSVs in lending\.
  5. Select truth -> Upload -> pick truth_customer_crosswalk.csv.

IMPORTANT: do not rename any file to start with an underscore ( _ ).
Spark treats _files as hidden and will fail to read them.

Scale: demo  |  Seed: 42
payments: 2000 customers, 3026 accounts, 48710 transactions (1710 fraud)
lending:  900 borrowers, 472 loans, 73 delinquencies
600 people appear in BOTH systems (entity resolution unifies them).
